metadata.title: Vibrant Feather Collage with Heavy Sans-Serif

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast composition featuring saturated primary-colored feathers against a bright yellow background with heavy, top-aligned black typography.
triggerTerms: bold black display type on yellow
primary color feathers with harsh shadows
excludeWhen: realistic nature photography without graphic manipulation is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A square graphic layout dominated by a vibrant yellow field, featuring four distinct feathers in red, blue, purple, and black/magenta, each casting a sharp, dark shadow. A heavy, black, sans-serif wordmark is positioned in the top-left corner, partially cropped by the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast interaction between saturated subject colors and a bright yellow background
Sharp, directional shadows creating a sense of depth and physical presence
Heavy typographic weight balancing the organic, wispy textures of the feathers
Asymmetrical arrangement of feathers leading the eye from the center to the corners
coreInvariants: Sharp, dark drop shadows for all subjects
Heavy black sans-serif display type in the top-left corner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Feathers are distributed across the center and right quadrants, varying in scale from medium to large.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red feather in the center-left acts as the primary focal point due to its size and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold black text in the top-left, moves down the red feather, across to the blue feather, and up to the smaller purple feather.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant yellow negative space surrounds the subjects, emphasizing their color and form.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Primary Red, Cobalt Blue, and Magenta (Feathers)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation across all hues with deep black values for contrast.
paletteRestrictions: Pure black for shadows and type

composition.overlap: partially cropped by top and left edges
composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the background, clear of main subjects

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy weight for maximum impact; no secondary typeface.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric skeleton and heavy presence.
Provides the necessary visual weight and blocky feel.
Offers the required density and vertical presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a flat, saturated yellow background. Place four feathers (red, blue, purple, and black with magenta edges) in an asymmetrical cluster. Each feather must cast a sharp, dark, directional shadow to the upper right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single word in the top-left corner using an extra-bold geometric sans-serif font in solid black. The text should be tightly kerned and positioned so the tops of the letters are slightly cropped by the frame edge.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant yellow?
Are the shadows sharp and dark rather than soft?
Is the typography extra-bold and black?
Are the feathers in primary/saturated colors?

mustRedesign: Do not use thin or serif fonts
Do not use soft, diffused lighting
Do not use muted or earth-tone palettes
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is solid black and extra-bold.
Ensure the yellow background is uniform and bright.
Verify that each feather has a distinct, sharp shadow.
Confirm the composition feels balanced but asymmetrical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Saturated Background + Primary Subject + Sharp Shadow + Heavy Sans-Serif Wordmark
